On bleeding, patient says “when I scratched it, yes, it has bled sometimes, but… otherwise it hasn't bled on its own,” indicating bleeding only after scratching.
Patient notes “I have dryness, like, you know, in other parts, like my legs, but it's not… very… it's just a little bit of dryness in my legs,” supporting mild chronic dry skin on legs.
Doctor asks about “fever or temperatures” and patient answers “No,” indicating denial of fever.

Doctor asks “Any problems with your urine? Waterworks?” and contextually receives no concerns; the patient continues with “Yeah, I feel good” when asked if otherwise well, implying denial of urinary issues.
Doctor asks “You're eating and drinking. Your appetite is well maintained?” and patient answers “Yeah, I feel good,” supporting intact appetite.
